theorems.name: Submission.f036cc6b1f_pic_mec_pointwise_sign_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (E F X : Set UpperHalfPlane), (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → MeasurableSet E → MeasurableSet F → MeasurableSet X → (∀ (γ : Δ) (z : UpperHalfPlane), (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) • z ∈ X ↔ z ∈ X) → (∀ S : Set UpperHalfPlane, (S = E ∨ S = F) → ∀ z ∈ X, ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ S ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ Δ → δ • z ∈ S → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → ∃ A B : Δ → Set UpperHalfPlane, (∀ γ, MeasurableSet (A γ)) ∧ (∀ γ, MeasurableSet (B γ)) ∧ Pairwise (fun γ δ => Disjoint (A γ) (A δ)) ∧ Pairwise (fun γ δ => Disjoint (B γ) (B δ)) ∧ (⋃ γ, A γ) = E ∩ X ∧ (⋃ γ, B γ) = F ∩ X ∧ (∀ γ : Δ, (fun z : UpperHalfPlane => (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)⁻¹ • z) '' (A γ) = B γ)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted sign-transversal and measurable-slice partition lemmas, reindexes by inversion, and uses invariance of X for the image correspondence.
